{{Top|leg}}
The '''High-Yield Universal Institutional Savings Account''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] savings account that parents could establish in the name of their children. It was known to be one of the most profitable and stable accounts available. With an excellent yearly return rate, it was used to finance the pursuit of education throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] established one for his son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]], before he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].
